subject: Re: MAP & evaluation gates — proposed staggered adoption thresholds
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@neurobank.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: alyssa.rey@neurobank.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff + evaluation scope for pilot

Hi Alex / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We want to land a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties evaluation milestones to commercial triggers so we can move from PoC to production quickly. High-level asks from our side: 

- A two-month evaluation window with monthly checkpoints (TPM targets for each month).
- Clear acceptance criteria for each milestone (latency P95, token cost per 1M, and quality checks on our prompt set).
- Proposed commit ladder and associated discount tiers if we meet the milestones.

Attached is a short spreadsheet with our expected monthly token profile (neurobank-mop-v1.xlsx). Can you propose a MAP timeline and an initial pricing ladder we could take to procurement?

Would prefer a tight close — ideally contract signed within 30 days of hitting the evaluation acceptance gate. Happy to jump on a follow-up call if helpful.

Thanks,
Samira
Director of ML Platforms
NeuroBank

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@neurobank.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation scope for pilot

Samira — great to hear. I pulled the spreadsheet into a quick eval-plan doc (attached: redwood-eval-plan.pdf) and sketched a staggered approach that matches what you asked for. Key proposal summary: 

1) Evaluation period: 8 weeks (two monthly checkpoints)
  - Month 1 (eval): baseline testing, P95 latency target <= 220ms, 1M token cost estimate 
  - Month 2 (stress): scale to target TPM, KV/prefix cache validation, final QA pass

2) MAP gates & commercial triggers: 
  - Gate A (end of Week 4): acceptance if avg P95 and sample prompt quality met -> commit to a soft monthly TPM of 75k tokens (for month 1 of committed stage) with a 5% onboarding credit.
  - Gate B (end of Week 8): if pass -> ramp to committed monthly TPM 250k tokens with negotiated volume discount tier.

3) Pricing ladder (indicative): 
  - Up to 100k TPM: standard hosted pricing (no commit)
  - 100k-300k TPM committed: 12% discount off list for the first 6 months
  - 300k+ TPM committed: 18% discount + custom support SLA

4) Close timeline suggestion: 
  - If Gate A is met, execute a short SOW amendment and a 60-day activation contract to start month-on-month committed billing. Aim for procurement signature within 10 business days of Gate A.

Ben — looping you for the commercial/discount confirmation and to prepare a concise SOW amendment for procurement.

Happy to jump on call Friday morning to align on exact metrics.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, Samira Khan <samira@neurobank.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation scope for pilot

Thanks Alex / Samira. I reviewed the ladder — generally OK but want to align incentives around ramp velocity. Two suggested edits: 

- Move the soft commit at Gate A to a 90k TPM floor (so we avoid a sub-threshold billing band) and apply a 7% onboarding credit that is refundable against first invoice.
- For Gate B, make the 18% discount conditional on sustaining >= 350k TPM for 2 consecutive months (otherwise revert to 12%).

I'll draft the amendment language so procurement can review quickly. Also, do we want a short SLA credit for missed P95 at Gate B (e.g., 2% of monthly invoice per missed week capped at 8%)? That would reassure your ops folks.

Ben Carter
Lead Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira@neurobank.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, alex.martinez@redwood.ai
Cc: alyssa.rey@neurobank.ai
Date: 2026-10-13T07:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation scope for pilot

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement and product: 

- Procurement prefers a monthly billed commit (not daily) and requests a 30-day termination notice after the initial 6-month committed window.
- Product asks that the quality gate include a blind eval with our 120 prompt set; we’ll share scoring metrics by Tue.
- Regarding the SLA credit: acceptable, but cap should be 5% of monthly invoice.

If you can send a redline SOW amendment and a short mutual action plan document with explicit dates for Gate A and Gate B, we can get legal/procurement started.

Samira

From: alex.martinez@redwood.ai
To: Samira Khan <samira@neurobank.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation scope for pilot

Attached is a draft MAP / SOW amendment (DocuSign link below) reflecting Ben's edits and your procurement asks. Highlights: 

- Gate A date: 2026-11-08 (end of Week 4) — target soft commit 90k TPM, 7% onboarding credit refundable on invoice 1.
- Gate B date: 2026-12-06 (end of Week 8) — conditional 18% discount if >=350k TPM for two months, else 12%.
- Term: 6 months minimum committed, 30-day termination notice after the initial term.
- SLA credit: 3% capped (compromise).

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/templates/nb-sow-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Please review; I can route to procurement/legal once you give verbal OK.

Regards,
Alex

From: Alyssa Rey <alyssa.rey@neurobank.ai>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + evaluation scope for pilot

This looks good from procurement. We signed the NDA earlier today (attached: nda-signed.pdf) and procurement will circulate a redline within 48 hours if needed. Two quick asks before legal review: 

- Can you export the monthly TPM schedule as a CSV (so procurement can ingest the volume ladder into their billing system)?
- Please include a short acceptance test plan (we'll need the blind eval details and sampling cadence).

If both items are included with the DocuSign, legal will likely approve the amendment quickly. Looking forward to Gate A next month.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Procurement Manager
NeuroBank
